clue.text: Moving a resolution

definitions.meaning: moving, so the noun names the state of movement
a proposal put formally to a meeting for a vote

explanation.surface: Someone proposes a resolution at a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both movement in general and a formal proposal tabled at a meeting for debate.

clue.text: Low gear involved-finding place to park?

parts.note: a cow lows, making the sound moo

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters of gear are jumbled

explanation.surface: A driver in low gear hunting for a parking space.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Low gear' reads as a car's gearbox setting, and the question mark warns that 'park' is about mooring boats, not cars.
explanation.definitionFit: A berth where a vessel is tied up is a kind of nautical parking space.

clue.text: Work taken up by writer having no alternative

definitions.text: Work taken up by writer having no alternative

parts.words: Work taken up by writer having no alternative
parts.note: a reference book that a writer short of an alternative word would reach for

explanation.surface: A writer with no other option takes on a job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No alternative' reads as having no choice, but means lacking an alternative word, which this reference book supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: A book of synonyms gives writers alternative words when they are stuck.

clue.text: Work appointment

definitions.meaning: a workplace, where business is done
a post or position someone is appointed to

explanation.surface: A job appointment.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a place of business and a position of public duty held by someone.

clue.text: In use, can turn into a problem

indicators.note: turn into says these letters change shape to form a new word

explanation.surface: Something in use may become troublesome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can' looks like a verb but is part of the fodder: 'turn into' rearranges IN USE CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: An annoyance or pest is a source of trouble.

clue.text: Customs of the American Middle West

indicators.note: Middle asks for the central letters of the word West

explanation.surface: A survey of the folk traditions of America's Midwest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Middle West' reads as a region, but 'Middle' takes the centre of WEST, ES.
explanation.definitionFit: Habits and practices are a group's usual ways of doing things.

clue.text: Glance at the fixtures-not much on

parts.note: to scan is to glance over quickly
ties are matches or fixtures in a sports competition

explanation.surface: Someone glancing down the list of sports fixtures.
explanation.definitionFit: Skimpy underwear leaves the wearer with very little clothing.

clue.text: One is upset by such a din

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is upset by a racket.
explanation.definitionFit: A racket or loud sound is an unpleasant clamour.

clue.text: Choose gold constituent

parts.note: to elect is to choose
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Picking a gold component.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constituent' means a voter in a constituency, not an ingredient.
explanation.definitionFit: A voter in a constituency is someone who chooses a representative.

clue.text: Individual not working, just this once

parts.note: one is a single individual
a machine that is off is not working

explanation.surface: A single person is off work just this once.
explanation.definitionFit: Something happening only once, never repeated, is a unique occasion.

clue.text: Adjourn, when all square in court?

definitions.meaning: to put off or lay aside for later
on a tennis court, a set level between the two players would be a set with each side equal

explanation.surface: A judge adjourns when the case is evenly balanced.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading takes the court as a tennis court: SET A-SIDE, a set evenly split by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting aside for later means postponing, and a level tennis set is jokily one shared by each side.

clue.text: Trick examination question

parts.note: a con is a trick or swindle
a test is an examination

explanation.surface: A trick question on an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispute or challenge something is to call it into doubt.

clue.text: Wreck on a chart finally fixed

indicators.note: wreck means destroy, so the letters of these words are broken and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A shipwreck marked on a nautical chart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wreck' is a verb rearranging ON A CHART, not a sunken ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship held in place by its hook after its voyage is moored and stationary.

clue.text: Declare at cricket-match

parts.note: a Test is an international cricket match

explanation.surface: Declaring at a cricket match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Declare' is also a cricket term for closing an innings, which helps the disguise.
explanation.definitionFit: To affirm or bear witness is to state something formally.

clue.text: Doubter is disposed to be intrusive

indicators.note: disposed means arranged, so the letters of doubter are set out anew

explanation.surface: A sceptic is inclined to butt in.
explanation.definitionFit: To push oneself forward unwanted is to impose on others.

clue.text: Don't work for nothing

parts.note: read as being paid for one's labour rather than as idleness

explanation.surface: Advice to stop working without pay, or to avoid working at all.
explanation.definitionFit: To be paid wages for labour means one does not toil unpaid.

clue.text: Its early closing might have prevented a loss

definitions.text: Its early closing might have prevented a loss

parts.words: Its early closing might have prevented a loss
parts.note: recalls the saying about shutting it after the horse has bolted

explanation.surface: Something that, shut sooner, would have stopped a loss.
explanation.walkthrough: The proverb 'to shut the stable door after the horse has bolted' means acting too late.
explanation.definitionFit: The barn entrance a horse escapes through if left open.

clue.text: Need month off when recovering

indicators.note: off means gone wrong, so the letters of these words are scrambled

explanation.surface: A patient needs a month off work while recuperating.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting better after illness is improving in health.

clue.text: Confine Brown without leave to military HQ

parts.note: to pen is to confine

indicators.note: without in the old sense of outside, so one piece wraps another

parts.note: tan is a brown colour
to go is to leave

explanation.surface: A soldier confined to base at headquarters for going absent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, so the colour wraps around the leaving; 'leave' looks like military leave, which suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The five-sided building in Virginia houses the US Department of Defense.

clue.text: They make up specific orders

parts.note: pharmacists who prepare prescriptions to order

explanation.surface: People who invent particular commands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make up' means prepare, not invent; 'specific' hints at medicines (specifics).
explanation.definitionFit: Chemists prepare and hand out medicines prescribed by doctors.

clue.text: Ruined roof end replaced

indicators.note: replaced means put back differently, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A ruined building whose roof end was replaced.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone finished or beyond saving is in a hopeless state.

clue.text: Close arrest

explanation.surface: A close arrest.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses mean bringing to a halt or ending.

clue.text: An empty form of recompense

indicators.note: form of says the letters are shaped into a different word

explanation.surface: An empty kind of reward.
explanation.definitionFit: Money handed over in return is a reward or compensation.

clue.text: Trail a wandering star

indicators.note: wandering means straying about, so the letters move into a new order

explanation.surface: A wandering star leaving a trail.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'wandering star' is a planet, but here 'wandering' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The brightest star in the constellation Aquila.

clue.text: Sun-worshippers take off for this state

definitions.text: Sun-worshippers take off for this state

parts.words: Sun-worshippers take off for this state
parts.note: sunbathers who strip off their clothes reach a bare condition

explanation.surface: Sunbathers fly off to a holiday destination state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take off for' suggests flying to a US state, but it means strip off clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Being naked is the condition of wearing no clothing at all.

clue.text: Incredible fiddle shown up in this boardgame

indicators.note: in a down clue, shown up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a Strad is a Stradivarius, a superb violin

explanation.surface: A remarkable cheat exposed in a board game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fiddle' means a violin, not a swindle; reversing STRAD gives the pub game played at a board.
explanation.definitionFit: The pub game of throwing pointed missiles at a circular board.

clue.text: Infidelity of naughty Audrey seen embracing naval officer

indicators.note: embracing says one set of letters holds another inside
naughty means badly behaved, so the letters of Audrey run wild

parts.note: Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant

explanation.surface: Naughty Audrey caught embracing a naval officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'naughty' rearranges the name into ADUERY, which then wraps around the officer's abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unfaithful to a spouse is marital betrayal.

clue.text: Sandpiper in difficulty

definitions.meaning: a small wading bird of the sandpiper family
a tangle or problem, as in a knotty issue

explanation.surface: A wading bird in trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a small wading bird and also a tangle or problem.

clue.text: State iron is about to be fixed

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece wraps round the other

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
Oregon is a US state

explanation.surface: A state's iron industry is to be settled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State' looks like a verb meaning declare, but it is a US state, wrapped by the iron symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: A result determined in advance, as in a foregone conclusion, is predetermined.

clue.text: Animal disease going round English riding school

indicators.note: going round says the first piece encircles the second

parts.note: mange is a skin disease of animals

explanation.surface: An animal disease spreading around an English riding school.
explanation.definitionFit: An arena where horses are trained in dressage.

clue.text: No Easter break? That'll have repercussions

indicators.note: break means smash, so the letters are pieced together again

explanation.surface: Losing the Easter holiday will cause trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' looks like a holiday, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To echo or reverberate is to have lasting effects.

clue.text: Believe one side of the account

definitions.meaning: the column in a ledger opposite debit

explanation.surface: Believing one side of a story.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to trust a claim and also the entries recording money received in a ledger.
